summary: Verified login flow bug fix (axios 401 interceptor hijacking login). All 5 scenarios PASS: wrong password stays on /arc/login with error toast, retry with correct pwd succeeds, session survives dashboard reload, operation & finance users login successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js line 15-17: calling nav('/') inside render body during render is an anti-pattern (side-effect during render). Should be wrapped in useEffect. Not blocking, but flags a lint/react-strict-mode concern.
auth.js: no /auth/logout backend call — pure client-side logout. Consider server-side token invalidation if using JWT refresh strategy.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, operation/operation123, finance/finance123 — all working. Wrong pwd 'admin/wrongpass123' returns 401 with toast 'Username atau password salah'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow now solid. api.js 401 interceptor correctly skips /auth/login and uses PUBLIC_URL-aware pathname comparison. Frontend served under /arc/ prefix. Dashboard renders KPIs, recurring expenses, quick actions after login.
rca of the issue: Original bug: axios response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js cleared localStorage + redirected to '/login' on ANY 401, including login endpoint's own 401. Since app is served under /arc/, pathname comparison to '/login' (missing prefix) always mismatched, causing forced full-page navigation to /login, which resolved to /arc/login again — producing the observed rapid refresh. Fix: (1) skip interceptor cleanup when request URL matches /auth/login regex; (2) compare pathname against (PUBLIC_URL + '/login'). Verified: 401 on wrong pwd now surfaces toast, no reload, retry works.
